All ledger tests pass. Now policy projection tests. Let me verify the output fields for various privacy/egress/mode combinations.

Test matrix:
- access, no PPI, privacy absent, internal → identity=default, from=default, pai=[default]
- access, no PPI, privacy absent, external → pai=[]
- access, no PPI, privacy none, external → pai=[default]
- access, no PPI, privacy id, internal → from=anon, pai=[default]
- access, no PPI, privacy id, external → from=anon, pai=[]
- access, PPI [sip:desk, tel], internal → identity=sip:desk, pai=[sip:desk, tel]
- access, PPI single tel → identity=tel:+..., pai=[tel:+...]
- relay, PAI single → account=owner, identity=that URI, pai=[URI]
- relay, PAI 2 → ordered
- relay, PAI account not in peer accounts → identity
- relay with privacy id → from anon

Let me write these as explicit expected-output checks.

cd /app/dev && cat > t_policy.py << 'PYEOF'
from harness import *

ACC = [{'id': 'alice', 'default': 'sip:alice@lab.test',
        'aliases': ['sip:alice@lab.test', 'sip:desk@lab.test', 'tel:+12025550100']},
       {'id': 'bob', 'default': 'sip:bob@lab.test', 'aliases': ['sip:bob@lab.test']}]
PEERS = [{'id': 'edge', 'mode': 'access', 'accounts': []},
         {'id': 'trunk', 'mode': 'relay', 'accounts': ['alice']},
         {'id': 'trunk2', 'mode': 'relay', 'accounts': ['bob']},
         {'id': 'norelay', 'mode': 'relay', 'accounts': []}]

fails = 0
def proj(desc, wire, peer='edge', auth='alice', egress='internal', expect=None, reason=None):
    global fails
    out = run(envelope([ev(0, peer=peer, auth=auth, egress=egress, wire=wire)], accounts=ACC, peers=PEERS))
    r = out['results'][0]
    if reason is not None:
        if r['decision'] != 'reject' or r['reason'] != reason:
            fails += 1; print('FAIL', desc, 'expected reject', reason, 'got', r)
        return
    got = (r['account'], r['identity'], r['from'], r['pai'], r['privacy'])
    if got != expect:
        fails += 1; print('FAIL', desc, '\n  expected', expect, '\n  got     ', got)

P2 = 'P-Preferred-Identity: <sip:desk@lab.test>, <tel:+12025550100>'
P1 = 'P-Preferred-Identity: <tel:+12025550100>'
A1 = 'P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:alice@lab.test>'
A2 = 'P-Asserted-Identity: <tel:+12025550100>, <sip:desk@lab.test>'

proj('access default internal', req(), expect=('alice', 'sip:alice@lab.test', 'sip:alice@lab.test', ['sip:alice@lab.test'], 'absent'))
proj('access default external', req(), egress='external', expect=('alice', 'sip:alice@lab.test', 'sip:alice@lab.test', [], 'absent'))
proj('access none external', req(extra=['Privacy: none']), egress='external', expect=('alice', 'sip:alice@lab.test', 'sip:alice@lab.test', ['sip:alice@lab.test'], 'none'))
proj('access id internal', req(extra=['Privacy: id']), expect=('alice', 'sip:alice@lab.test', 'sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid', ['sip:alice@lab.test'], 'id'))
proj('access id external', req(extra=['Privacy: id']), egress='external', expect=('alice', 'sip:alice@lab.test', 'sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid', [], 'id'))
proj('access ppi2 internal', req(extra=[P2]), expect=('alice', 'sip:desk@lab.test', 'sip:desk@lab.test', ['sip:desk@lab.test', 'tel:+12025550100'], 'absent'))
proj('access ppi1 tel', req(extra=[P1]), expect=('alice', 'tel:+12025550100', 'tel:+12025550100', ['tel:+12025550100'], 'absent'))
proj('access ppi2 external none', req(extra=[P2, 'Privacy: none']), egress='external', expect=('alice', 'sip:desk@lab.test', 'sip:desk@lab.test', ['sip:desk@lab.test', 'tel:+12025550100'], 'none'))
proj('access pai discarded', req(extra=['P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:bob@lab.test>']), expect=('alice', 'sip:alice@lab.test', 'sip:alice@lab.test', ['sip:alice@lab.test'], 'absent'))
proj('access pai unknown discarded', req(extra=['P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:stranger@else.test>']), expect=('alice', 'sip:alice@lab.test', 'sip:alice@lab.test', ['sip:alice@lab.test'], 'absent'))
proj('access ppi not alias', req(extra=['P-Preferred-Identity: <sip:bob@lab.test>']), reason='identity')
proj('access ppi partial bad', req(extra=['P-Preferred-Identity: <sip:desk@lab.test>, <sip:bob@lab.test>']), reason='fields')
proj('access unauth', req(), auth=None, reason='auth')
proj('access unauth beats identity', req(from_='sip:stranger@lab.test'), auth=None, reason='auth')
proj('access unauth beats fields?', req(from_='sip:stranger@lab.test', tag=''), auth=None, reason='fields')

proj('relay pai1', req(extra=[A1]), peer='trunk', auth=None, expect=('alice', 'sip:alice@lab.test', 'sip:alice@lab.test', ['sip:alice@lab.test'], 'absent'))
proj('relay pai2 ordered', req(extra=[A2]), peer='trunk', auth=None, expect=('alice', 'sip:desk@lab.test', 'sip:desk@lab.test', ['sip:desk@lab.test', 'tel:+12025550100'], 'absent'))
proj('relay external absent', req(extra=[A1]), peer='trunk', auth=None, egress='external', expect=('alice', 'sip:alice@lab.test', 'sip:alice@lab.test', [], 'absent'))
proj('relay external id', req(extra=[A1, 'Privacy: id']), peer='trunk', auth=None, egress='external', expect=('alice', 'sip:alice@lab.test', 'sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid', [], 'id'))
proj('relay internal id', req(extra=[A1, 'Privacy: id']), peer='trunk', auth=None, expect=('alice', 'sip:alice@lab.test', 'sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid', ['sip:alice@lab.test'], 'id'))
proj('relay no pai', req(), peer='trunk', auth=None, reason='identity')
proj('relay ppi present', req(extra=[A1, P1]), peer='trunk', auth=None, reason='identity')
proj('relay not allowed acct', req(extra=['P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:bob@lab.test>']), peer='trunk', auth=None, reason='identity')
proj('relay allowed bob', req(extra=['P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:bob@lab.test>'], from_='sip:bob@lab.test', to='<sip:alice@lab.test>', target='sip:alice@lab.test'), peer='trunk2', auth=None, expect=('bob', 'sip:bob@lab.test', 'sip:bob@lab.test', ['sip:bob@lab.test'], 'absent'))
proj('relay empty accounts list', req(extra=[A1]), peer='norelay', auth=None, reason='identity')
proj('relay from must match pai owner', req(extra=[A1], from_='sip:desk@lab.test'), peer='trunk', auth=None, expect=('alice', 'sip:alice@lab.test', 'sip:desk@lab.test', ['sip:alice@lab.test'], 'absent'))
proj('relay from anon without id', req(extra=[A1], from_='sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid'), peer='trunk', auth=None, reason='identity')
proj('relay from anon with id', req(extra=[A1, 'Privacy: id'], from_='sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid'), peer='trunk', auth=None, expect=('alice', 'sip:alice@lab.test', 'sip:anonymous@anonymous.invalid', ['sip:alice@lab.test'], 'id'))
proj('relay unknown pai alias', req(extra=['P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:ghost@lab.test>']), peer='trunk', auth=None, reason='identity')
proj('relay two owners', req(extra=['P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:alice@lab.test>, <tel:+12025550100>']), peer='trunk2', auth=None, reason='identity')
proj('relay pai syntax still checked', req(extra=['P-Asserted-Identity: <sip:alice@lab.test>, <sip:alice@lab.test>']), peer='trunk', auth=None, reason='fields')

# INVITE works too
proj('invite', req(method='INVITE'), expect=('alice', 'sip:alice@lab.test', 'sip:alice@lab.test', ['sip:alice@lab.test'], 'absent'))
print('policy fails:', fails)
PYEOF
python3 t_policy.py
